note: Fig. 9.1 is a shape diagram, not a structural formula: four sp3 lobes drawn on a central atom, three of them bonded to labels CH3 and the fourth shaded as the unshared electron pair, with the 108 degree angle marked. The central atom carries no printed element symbol; it is read as nitrogen from the lone pair and from the caption and running text, which name the molecule trimethylamine. Hence one species, N(CH3)3. The pyramidal drawing shows geometry only and fixes no stereodescriptor (three identical methyls plus a lone pair is not a stereocentre), so no stereochemistry is written. The 108 degree bond angle and the lone-pair lobe have no SMILES representation and are not encoded.
